show.name: 2024 Seoul International Fireworks Festival
show.location: Yeouido Hangang Park, Seoul, Republic of Korea

observers.name: Scene origin reference observer
observers.notes: Reproduces the observer previously hardcoded in simulator/app.py and recorded in assets/ATTRIBUTION.md. This is a scene reference point chosen for the OSM extract, NOT an attested position where any spectator stood on 2024-10-05.

seeds.notes: Matches the previous SimulationConfig.random_seed. Subsystem seeds are derived by name through SeedRegistry.derive so a new stochastic consumer cannot perturb existing sequences.

show.license: Public information page, terms not restated here; used as a factual reference only
show.uncertainty: Published schedule window; individual segment times are not published
show.notes: Seoul Metropolitan Government culture listing gives the 19:20-20:30 KST window and identifies the presentation area around Wonhyo Bridge. It does not publish barge coordinates or a firing timeline. Independently corroborated for event extent by the 2024-10-03 Seoul safety notice, https://culture.seoul.go.kr/culture/bbs/B0000000/view.do?menuNo=200050&nttId=13326

reference_epoch.notes: Chosen inside the official show window and between the 19:00 and 20:00 weather samples so that time interpolation is exercised rather than an endpoint. Selecting a reference instant is a project convention; grade C records that it is neither an observation nor a reconstruction.

origin.license: Scene extract derived from OpenStreetMap data, ODbL
origin.uncertainty: Definition, not a measurement; must remain identical to the origin baked into assets/yeouido_scene.npz
origin.notes: Local East-Up-South frame origin. Recorded in assets/ATTRIBUTION.md as the scene origin of the 37.515-37.545 N, 126.910-126.960 E OSM extract. Changing this value invalidates the shipped scene asset.

render_vertical_datum.coordinate_reference_system: Local vertical datum; horizontal EPSG:3857 source tiles
render_vertical_datum.uncertainty: The geodetic vertical datum of the Terrarium elevation source is not documented in this repository
render_vertical_datum.notes: Simulation y=0 is the median Terrarium DEM elevation beneath the Han River mask (5.01 m in the source model). The datum that 5.01 m is itself expressed in is UNVERIFIED, so absolute-height claims must not be made against MSL or any national datum until resolved. Required dataset #10 in DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

observers.uncertainty: Scene reference point; horizontal position is the scene origin and the 5 m height is a nominal eye-level-above-datum value
observers.notes: This observer exists to preserve the previously hardcoded astronomy observer so existing tests and documented celestial values remain reproducible. It is NOT a claim that anyone observed the 2024 show from this point. A real observer position requires either a stated viewing location or landmark-based camera pose estimation from footage.

launch_sites.uncertainty: No dated source with barge or firing-position coordinates has been located
launch_sites.notes: EMPTY BY DESIGN. The official listing and the 2024-10-03 safety notice give the presentation area (Mapo Bridge to 63 City, around Wonhyo Bridge) but no coordinates. Populating this with an estimate would convert an unknown into an apparent measurement. Required dataset #2 in DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

events.uncertainty: No firing timeline or shell manifest for 2024-10-05 has been located
events.notes: EMPTY BY DESIGN. Required dataset #1 in DATA_PROVENANCE.md: per-shot launch time, site, calibre, and shell type. Until supplied, the simulator has no historical performance to replay, and any show it renders is a grade-D synthetic sequence that must be labelled as such.

seeds.notes: Master seed 20241005 preserves the previous SimulationConfig.random_seed so existing stochastic output is unchanged.

environment.weather.license: Meteostat terms; underlying observations reported as isd_lite
environment.weather.coordinate_reference_system: Point observation, Seoul station 47108; not a spatial field
environment.weather.units: degC, percent, hPa, m/s (converted from km/h), oktas
environment.weather.uncertainty: Hourly cadence; the 19:20 show start is a linear interpolation between the 19:00 and 20:00 samples
environment.weather.notes: File assets/yeouido_2024-10-05_environment.json. Wind bearings are converted to East-Up-South vectors before interpolation to avoid the 360/0 degree discontinuity.

environment.vertical_wind_profile.uncertainty: Provisional neutral profile scaling the 10 m station wind to 1.4x at 100 m
environment.vertical_wind_profile.notes: Not an event-night sounding. Must be replaced if radiosonde or lidar data for 2024-10-05 becomes available. Required dataset #7 in DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

scene.osm.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
scene.osm.uncertainty: Plan geometry is dated and authoritative. Tagged heights are grade A; building:levels x 3.2 m is grade C; the 12 m fallback for untagged buildings is grade D.
scene.osm.notes: File assets/yeouido_scene.npz. Overpass attic query fixed to the show-start OSM state within 37.515-37.545 N, 126.910-126.960 E. Han River water is OSM relation 152336. The checksum covers the derived asset including the procedurally placed site detail, so it changes when tools/build_site_details.py is re-run even though the OSM extract behind it does not.

scene.terrain.coordinate_reference_system: EPSG:3857 source tiles resampled to local East-Up-South metres
scene.terrain.uncertainty: Effective source resolution approximately 30 m at this latitude; cannot resolve levees, stairs, or the riverside viewing surface
scene.terrain.notes: Bare-earth regional baseline, not a survey. Higher zoom levels may be resampled from coarser sources, so zoom is not a statement of survey resolution. Replacement is required dataset #8 in DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

scene.site_details.license: Official facility map; used as a positional reference only
scene.site_details.uncertainty: Current inventory, not a 2024 archive; existence on 2024-10-05 is unverified and dimensions/headings are procedural
scene.site_details.notes: File assets/yeouido_official_facilities.json. Street lamps, benches, and railings have no dated point source at all and are explicitly inferred LOD geometry (grade D).

astronomy.coordinate_reference_system: Topocentric horizontal, of-date equinox, with aberration and refraction
astronomy.uncertainty: Library algorithm accuracy; the applied twilight illuminance anchors and the 0.25 lux full-moon reference are grade C calibration models
astronomy.notes: Sun and Moon only. Planets are not yet computed, and the rendered star field is a synthetic grade-D catalogue (simulator/environmental_optics.py), not astrometry.
